about.text: Comes in four varieties, named queijos-de-minas frescal (fresh), meia-cura (half-aged) and curado (aged). A fourth variety, branded queijo padrão ("standard" cheese) has been developed more recently and can be found in nearly all supermarkets and grocery stores in Brazil.

sources.text: Frescal is served 4 to 10 days after making (sourced); meia-cura and curado have no stated time, upper bound estimated
